english.title: Recklessly furnish false statement re financial circumstances order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) recklessly furnished a statement that was false in a material particular in pursuance of a financial circumstances order made by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE ORDER MADE..) under section 35 of the Sentencing Act 2020, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 36(3)(b) and (4) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

english.notes:
(i) Section 36(3)(a) makes it an offence to make a false statement in furnishing a statement in pursuance of a financial circumstances order, section 36(3)(c) to knowingly fail to disclose a material fact, see H22530/SE20008 and H22532/SE20010.
(ii) Section 36(1) makes failure to comply with a financial circumstances order an offence, see H22529/SE20007.
(iii) Proceedings for this offence may be commenced at any time which is both within two years from the date of the offence and within six months from its first discovery by the prosecutor, see section 36(5).
